title: Chapter One: Village by the Mountain
content:
Chapter One: The Village by the Mountain

Er Liangzi opened his eyes wide, staring straight at the black thatched roof made of grass and mud. The old quilt covering him had turned a deep yellow, with its original appearance barely recognizable, and a faint musty smell lingering in the air.。Next to him was his second brother, Han Zhu, who was sound asleep and snoring lightly and heavily from time to time.。About half a foot away from the bed is a mud wall, which has cracked over time. From these cracks, faint complaints from Mrs. Han can be heard, occasionally mixed with the sound of Mr. Han sucking on a dry tobacco pipe.。Erliangzi slowly closed his slightly tired eyes, forcing himself to enter into a deep sleep as soon as possible.。He knew very well that if he didn't go to sleep honestly, he wouldn't be able to get up early tomorrow, and he wouldn't be able to go into the mountains to pick firewood with his agreed companions.。Erliang's last name is Han and his first name is Li. His parents couldn't come up with a proper name, so his father named him after the two coarse bread buns made by his father, and asked Uncle Zhang from the village to give him a name.。When Uncle Zhang was young, he used to be a companion reader for wealthy people in the city for a few years. He was the only literate person in the village who knew a few characters. Many of the children's names in the village were actually given by him.。Han Li is called "Er Lengzi" by the people in the village, but he is not really stupid or silly. Instead, he is one of the smartest children in the village. However, like other children in the village, apart from his family, he rarely hears anyone formally call him by his name "Han Li". Instead, the nickname "Er Lengzi" has always been with him.。And the reason why he was given the nickname "Second Dumb" by others was simply because there was already a child named "Dumb" in the village.。It's no big deal. The other children in the village are also constantly called names like "dog child" and "second egg". These names may not necessarily sound better than "second fool".。Therefore, although Han Li does not like this title, he can only continue to comfort himself like this.。Han Li looks very ordinary on the outside, with dark skin, just like a typical rural child.。But deep inside, he was much more mature than his peers. From a young age, he longed for the rich and bustling world outside, dreaming that one day he could leave this tiny village and see the outside world that Old Uncle Zhang often talked about.。Han Li has never dared to mention this idea to anyone else.。Otherwise, it will definitely make the villagers feel surprised, a little kid who is not even weaned, actually has such a thought that even adults dare not easily think of.。You know, other kids about the same age as Han Li can only chase chickens and touch dogs in the village, let alone have such a strange idea of leaving their homeland.。Han Li's family has seven people, with two older brothers, one older sister, and one younger sister. He is the fourth in the family, just ten years old this year. Their family lives a very frugal life, only able to eat a few meals with meat and fish in a year. The whole family has been struggling to make ends meet.。At this time, Han Li was in a daze, as if he was half asleep and half awake, and there was always a lingering thought in his mind: when going up the mountain, he must help his beloved sister, pick more of her favorite red berries to eat.。At noon the next day, when Han Li was carrying a half-height stack of firewood under the scorching sun, with a bag full of berries in his arms, he didn't know that a guest had arrived at home who would change his destiny forever.。This distinguished guest is a close relative of his, his third uncle.。I heard that in a small town nearby, there is a tavern where he serves as the boss, which is the powerful person in his parents' words.。For the past hundred years, the Han family may have only had Uncle San, who is a somewhat distinguished relative.。Han Li has only seen this third uncle a few times when he was very young.。His older brother got a job as an apprentice to an old blacksmith in the city, which was introduced by this third uncle. This third uncle often asked people to bring some food and necessities to his parents, taking good care of their family. Therefore, Han Li had a good impression of this third uncle, knowing that although his parents didn't say it out loud, they were also very grateful in their hearts.。Big brother is the pride of the family. It is said that as an apprentice blacksmith, he not only takes care of food and accommodation, but also earns thirty copper coins a month. When he officially becomes a master and is hired by someone, he will earn even more money.。Whenever my parents mention my older brother, they light up and look like a different person.。Han Li, although young, also envied it very much. He had long had the best job in mind, which was to be noticed by a craftsman in the small town, to be taken on as an apprentice, and to become a respectable person who earned a living by his skills.。So when Han Li saw his third uncle, who was wearing a brand new satin outfit, with a chubby round face and a small mustache, he was extremely excited.。After putting the firewood in the back of the house, he shyly greeted Uncle San in the front room, obediently saying, "Hello, Uncle San," and stood quietly on the side, listening to his parents chatting with Uncle San.。Uncle San smiled and looked at Han Li, sizing him up, praising him with a few words like "obedient" and "sensible", then turned to his parents and talked about the purpose of this visit.。Han Li, although young, could not fully understand San Shu's words, but he also roughly understood the general meaning.。The restaurant where San Shu works belongs to a martial arts sect called "Seven Mysterious Gates". This sect has outer and inner disciples. Recently, San Shu officially became an outer disciple of this sect, and he can recommend children aged 7 to 12 to participate in the test to become inner disciples of the Seven Mysterious Gates.。The "Seven Mystical Gates" will start recruiting junior disciples for the test next month, which is held once every five years.。This uncle, who is somewhat shrewd and has no children of his own, naturally thought of the suitable Han Li.。Honest Han's father, who has always been honest and trustworthy, hesitated when he heard unfamiliar words like "jianghu" and "sect", unable to make up his mind.。He picked up the dry cigarette, took a few fierce puffs, and sat there in silence.。In Uncle San's mouth, "Seven Mysterious Gates" is naturally one of the great and top sects within hundreds of miles.。As long as you become an inner disciple, not only can you practice martial arts for free in the future without worrying about food and drink, but you can also have one or two extra pocket money every month.。And those who participate in the test, even if they are not selected, have the opportunity to become outsiders like Uncle San, specializing in managing the business outside the "Seven Mysterious Gates".。When he heard that he might be able to earn one or two silver coins every month, and have the opportunity to become a respectable person like Uncle San, Han's father finally made up his mind and agreed.。Uncle San was very happy to see Han's father agree.。Leave a few taels of silver, say come back to take Han Li away in a month, during this time, make some delicious food for Han Li, and help him to strengthen his body, to cope with the test.。Uncle San and Han's father said hello, patted Han Li's head, and then left for the city.。Han Li may not fully understand what his third uncle said, but he understands that being able to earn a lot of money by going into the city.。The long-held wish, which seemed possible to come true, kept him awake with excitement for several nights in a row.。Uncle San arrived at the village on time more than a month later, ready to take Han Li away. Before leaving, Han's father repeatedly urged Han Li to be honest and to be patient when encountering difficulties. He also advised him not to argue with others. Han's mother reminded him to take care of his health, eat well, and sleep well.。On the carriage, watching his parents' figures gradually getting farther away, Han Li bit his lips tightly, trying hard not to let the tears in his eyes fall.。Although he has always been more mature than other children since he was young, after all, he is still a ten-year-old child. The first time he went far away made him feel a little sad and lost.。His young heart secretly made a decision, to come back immediately when he earned a lot of money, and never be separated from his parents again.。Han Li never thought that the amount of money he had lost on this trip would be meaningless to him. He unexpectedly embarked on a path to immortality different from ordinary people, and walked out his own path of cultivation.。
